messages:
maya: quick heads-up: planning a sequential v2 cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. noticed a client signal issue - some mobile SDKs drop `X-Api-Version` on 204/empty responses. could cause implicit opt-out.

sam: do we have tenant list impacted? any large customers?

jordan: telemetry shows three tenants with repeated missing headers: tenant:acme-corp, tenant:oldbank, tenant:game-studio. low qps but mobile-heavy.

maya: proposal: pin those tenants to v1 for the change window, add a proxy probe that emits `client_header_missing.count` tagged by tenant, and delay shifting them until SDK patch is rolled out.

sam: SGTM on pin. can you paste deploy bot commands?

jordan: use deploy-bot pin commands:
```
/deploybot pin tenant:acme-corp v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z
/deploybot pin tenant:oldbank v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z
/deploybot pin tenant:game-studio v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z
```

deploy-bot: pinned 3 tenants to v1 (acme-corp, oldbank, game-studio). Pins expire 2026-04-02T06:00Z.

ops: will add probe + Grafana panel. alert if `client_header_missing.count > 5` for 5m tagged by tenant. also add an auto-pause hook: if probe spikes, pause shift. ETA 25m.

maya: rollback/runbook triggers: if 15m client-facing 5xx > 2% OR P95 latency increases > 300ms for canary tenants -> pause and unpin. also abort if deploy-bot reports >10% canary failures.

sam: updating release notes to call out SDK versions: "Mobile SDK < 3.1 may omit X-Api-Version on empty responses; upgrade or request tenant pinning." PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2748 :memo:

jordan: operational shim idea: treat missing header as v1 on a tenant exception (low-risk) if pinning breaks anything. prefer pin + SDK fix first.

maya: schedule: start sequential shift 2026-04-01T02:00Z with 5% ramp, check 15m, then 25%, 50%, 100% by 03:30 UTC. operator: @ops oncall first hour. i'll be in channel. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled sequential cutover job: start=2026-04-01T02:00:00Z, strategy=sequential(5%,25%,50%,100%), watch=15m, operators=(maya,ops).

ops: dashboard and probe created, alerting in place. will ping oncall when job starts.

maya: thanks all. will post updates during window and unpin once SDK rollout verified.
